A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

biological production in the northwestern Pacific Ocean during the last glaciomarine transition was mainly controlled by nutrient availability in the surface layer, which was influenced by eddies, not by the Oyashio Current.
the MWR off Sanriku was not a nutrient-poor region during the last glacio-eustatic cycle.

biological production in the northwestern Pacific was controlled by nutrient supply, not by the Oyashio Current, during both the last glacial and deglacial period.
